<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical methyl region (≈10–30 ppm) are at 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, and 14.05 ppm. These correspond to five distinct methyl carbons. The peak at 31.31 ppm is slightly downfield of the usual methyl range and likely represents a different carbon type. Therefore, the molecule contains five methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
